labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: the Update by a matching field load operation
labels.value: Update by a field you choose

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what Update by a matching field does and risks
labels.value: Finds the record whose field you choose (for example Email) holds the row's value and changes it. Nothing is created. Risk: a value several records hold follows the several-matches choice.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: the object has no field rows can be matched on
labels.value: This object has no text, email or phone field you can read and search by, so rows cannot be matched. Choose another action.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: update by a matching field has no field chosen
labels.value: Update by a field you choose needs the field rows are matched on. Choose it in the matching step.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: the chosen field cannot match rows; {0} is the field
labels.value: Rows cannot be matched on {0}: it is not a text, email or phone field of this object that you can read and search by. Choose another field.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: no column feeds the match field; {0} is the field
labels.value: Update by a field you choose needs a column mapped to {0}, the field rows are matched on.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: the row has no match value; {0} is the field
labels.value: This row has no {0}, which rows are matched on.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: no record holds the match value; {0} is the field
labels.value: No record you can see has this {0}. Check the value, or ask your Salesforce administrator for access to the record.

labels.shortDescription: Unindexed match field; {0} is the field, {1} the object, {2} the limit
labels.value: Records cannot be found by {0}: {1} holds more than {2} records, and Salesforce cannot search that many quickly by a field it does not index. Match by the record ID, the name, an email, or a field marked External ID or Unique.
